annotations.text:
The main flow, left to right: pick dinners, tick off what you already have, match at Tesco, then see exactly what landed.

The week's progress is a bar and a count, so it reads at a glance.

Alternative direction for the Meals screen.

Instead of a browse list, the week is five day slots you fill — better if dinners belong to particular nights, and it makes "eating out Tuesday" expressible.

Everything else stays as designed.
